title: Cad Ui Styling Consistency
description: Refactor CAD renderer DOM chrome to use @semio-tech/ui-react Tailwind design tokens instead of hardcoded hex inline styles; align selection overlays and attribute panels with playground UI.
summary: Aligned CAD renderer UI chrome and 3D scene materials with @semio-tech/ui-react design tokens: Tailwind classes for InteractionRepl overlays/aside, SelectionAttributesPanel/PropertiesPanel; spatialSceneColors() reads CSS variables for picks, previews, grid, and canvas.
